# GeniusCFO

> GeniusCFO is accounting automation software for Indian businesses and CA firms. It automates routine bookkeeping, prepares GST information and financial statements, and answers financial questions from updated accounts.

Last updated: 2026-08-11. Operated by GeniusCFO, serving India. Contact: marketing@geniuscfo.ai.
Full reference, including every published question and answer: [llms-full.txt](https://geniuscfo.ai/llms-full.txt).
Where this file and the website disagree, https://geniuscfo.ai is authoritative.

## Canonical pages

- [GeniusCFO for Business](https://geniuscfo.ai/business): An affordable AI CFO on phone and desktop for bookkeeping, GST information, bank reconciliation, financial answers, alerts and forecasts. Plans start at ₹999 per month and every plan begins with a 14-day free trial.
- [GeniusCFO for CA and Accounting Firms](https://geniuscfo.ai/ca-firms): An AI accounting team for every client, covering bookkeeping, GST information, financial statements and reconciliations while the firm retains professional judgement and final approval.
- [GeniusCFO Pricing](https://geniuscfo.ai/pricing): Plans for businesses (Light, Pro, Pro Max), plans for CA firms (Team, Enterprise), managed accounting services, optional add-ons and a 14-day free trial.

## Business product overview

GeniusCFO shows sales, profit, cash, receivables, payables, working capital and cash runway in one dashboard. Business owners can type or speak questions about profit, cash and GST, prepare GST information from updated books, match bank transactions with accounting entries, and use the product on phone or desktop.

## CA/Firm product overview

GeniusCFO automates routine bookkeeping entries and prepares GST information, the Statement of Profit and Loss, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement, Notes to Accounts and Trial Balance. It also supports bank reconciliation. CA firms review the work, apply professional judgement and retain final sign-off.

## Commercial notes

Prices exclude 18% GST; the GST-inclusive total is shown against the selected plan. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial and no credit card or UPI mandate is required to begin.

Plans for businesses cover one company with no extra members: Light at ₹999 per month, Pro at ₹1,999 per month and Pro Max at ₹2,999 per month. Plans for CA firms are priced by the client companies and team members included: Team at ₹3,999 per month covers three client companies and two extra members, and Enterprise at ₹6,999 per month covers ten client companies and five extra members. Additional client companies are ₹599 per month each and additional team members are ₹299 per month each.

Every plan includes the full product — books, GST, TDS, ITR, unlimited workflows and the Intelligence Hub. The tiers differ in how much AI is included, the level of support, and how many companies and members are covered.

Billing is monthly or every three months. The three-month option is billed once for three months of access and saves 20% against the monthly rate.

Managed accounting services are optional and billed separately: Accountant+ at ₹999 per month, CA+ at ₹2,999 per month and an Independent Statutory and Tax Auditor at ₹4,999 per financial year.

The website does not sell plans directly. Every pricing action books a demonstration with the GeniusCFO team; plans are chosen and paid for inside the product after the trial.
